projects.name: Agent Capability Model (ACaM) — Agentic security analysis
bullets: Developing a static + LLM-augmented pipeline to characterize security properties of LLM-based autonomous agents: taint tracking, capability boundary detection, and attack-surface enumeration.
Evaluating against real-world agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen) and synthesizing ground-truth benchmarks for controlled ablation.

projects.name: DISA — Learning-guided static disassembly & CFG recovery
bullets: Designed a transformer-based disassembly framework jointly recovering code layout and memory block boundaries on large stripped binaries.
Integrated memory block boundaries into a downstream block-level VSA-driven CFG recovery tool, improving control-flow via sound indirect call resolution.

projects.name: iResolveX — Hybrid indirect-call resolution
bullets: Multi-stage pipeline coupling high-recall target supersets with ML-guided re-ranking and bounded inter-procedural evidence support.
Produces p-IndirectCFG: a practical ranked-edge CFG enabling controllable precision–recall tradeoffs for IDA/Ghidra/angr consumers.

projects.name: Automated Multilayered Malware Classifier (2019–2022)
bullets: Designed and deployed an ensemble classifier combining basic/advanced static and dynamic analysis; introduced CFG-driven shallow+deep features integrated with an Application Whitelisting framework.

projects.name: Binary Vulnerability Detection via LLVM IR
bullets: Static analysis-driven detector for buffer overflows and memory leaks in third-party binaries; contributed LLVM IR-level data flow-analysis checks.

projects.name: Trusted Systems for I&C Networks (2017–2019)
bullets: Designed the in-house Hardware Reference Monitor (PCIe & USB): Secure Boot, Authentication, Remote Attestation for host/guest Linux and Windows.
Advanced Industrial Control Firewall (Modbus/TCP): DPI-based kernel module for application-layer policy enforcement between field and supervisory networks.

org: IIT Roorkee — BARC sponsored M.Tech Fellow

bullets: Proposed and implemented a novel remote attestation protocol addressing low extensibility and openness problems in existing schemes — published at IEEE TrustCom 2017.
